units.source_text: 是供养五大明王的佛事。

en.t: This was a Buddhist rite held to make offerings to the Five Great Wisdom Kings.

units.source_text: 中央不动尊，东坛降三世，西坛大威德，南坛军茶利夜叉，北坛金刚夜叉。

en.t: In the center was Fudo Myoo; on the eastern altar was Gozanze, on the western altar Daiitoku, on the southern altar Gundari Yasha, and on the northern altar Kongo Yasha.
